answers.core: This would be a general QoL improvement, not something project-specific. Importing it into every project would bloat their sizes, and also add unnecessary steps to the workflow of setting up a new project.
answers.workaround: It looks like it might possibly be doable with `EditorUndoRedoManager` or `UndoRedo` APIs, but would almost certainly require more work than just incorporating the extra information into the originally generated messages, and also probably be in a duplicate History tab.

title: Increase verbosity of undo and redo action names
